note: clarity-golden-03-parallelism-and-cohesion.md's checklist sentence mixes filing (gerund), to review (infinitive), and closing (gerund) as the heads of one coordinated series, exactly WILLIAMS-PARALLELISM's operational test for a series that does not share one grammatical form at the head word; the same sentence also embeds three comma-separated items inline, which is PLAIN-LISTS' own separate operational test, so both fire on the identical sentence at severity 2. The Notification Flow paragraph is where the two lanes diverge on the same passage: PLAIN-PARAGRAPH's scripted word-overlap heuristic flags the opening sentence directly, at severity 3, because the system, routes, and queue never recur anywhere else in the paragraph. WILLIAMS-COHESION's judged pass reads the same three sentences as connected discourse and reports a narrower, different breach, that the subject changes with no carryover from sentence one to sentence two specifically, even though the engineer does carry the topic from sentence two into sentence three, which is why this finding lands at severity 2 rather than 3: a single disruption the paragraph partly recovers from, not a subject that changes in every sentence with nothing ever picked back up.
